newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil still hopes to hold CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil still hopes to hold CVRD sale.

text.p: Brazil still hopes to hold the auction of a controlling stake in mining group Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) on Tuesday, said Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros, head of the National Development Bank (BNDES).
Mendonca de Barros said the government thought it had found a legal solution to a flurry of court injunctions suspending the auction, which it would use in the courts within 30 minutes.
Mendonca de Barros accused opponents of the CVRD privatization of of "illegitimate use and abuse of the legal system" by inundating the courts across the country with similar law suits.

Refusing to go into details, he said government lawyers had been working all day to find a "legal and constitutional way of avoiding such occurences" and would take their solution to he courts in half an hour.
"We were not prepared for this illegal and illegitimate mobilization on the part of a ferocious and hysterical opposition to the CVRD sale," he said.
"Our aim is to hold the auction today," Mendonca de Barros said, adding: "The enemy is not easy to defeat."
Mendonca de Barros said the Rio de Janeiro bolsa would be able to hold the auction until 2330 local/2230 EDT/0230 GMT.
The sale of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares was due to have taken place at 1000 local/1300 GMT on Tuesday, but has been delayed by a series of court injunctions.
